doc: Description-gate pins (ml/c3/desc_gate.py; pilot A root cause M2). Each head here lost more than 2 points under the live weights (Run E's INIT) when read with this code's texts instead of INIT's (desc_gate on 010038, 010387, holdout B with drafts as gold, graph rune,lattice_doc=1; ~/c3-local/runE/pilot/rootcause/fix/gate_fixed_rune.json), so it reads INIT's texts (runE/init_texts.json) until a refit or a run has learned the new ones. col:label_type keeps the new, contrast-free texts except physical_site, whose rewrite alone cost 010447 55 site rows. Unpin a head only with a desc_gate pass on its new text (after head_fit or judgment refit). C3_TEXT_PINS=0 reads every head's new text.
